meta.company: Chisos Boots (Austin TX handcrafted bootmaker, 90% DTC)
meta.thesis: Chisos does not need more boot designs - it needs buyers to stop losing the sizing gamble, and Get Fitted turns a $400 online boot purchase from a leap of faith into a guaranteed fit.
meta.variant_angle: fit-first DTC footwear campaign + boot prop

business_problem: Chisos sells $300-600 handcrafted boots online where fit is the whole risk: 250 analyzed reviews are 93% four-plus-star on quality, but the complaints that exist cluster hard on sizing and fit uncertainty - the one thing a screen can't resolve [R1][R2][S2][S5].

objectives.text: Drive 120 attributed orders (fit-event QR + code FITTED) in 45 days at ~$450 AOV
Capture 500 email/SMS signups via fit-check events and sizing-guide funnels
Reach 800K Texas impressions and shift 'boots are risky online' to 'Chisos gets the fit right' - +12 pts among surveyed shoppers

segments.name: Texas Boot Buyers (25-54)
segments.psychographic: wants real boots not fast-fashion; values craft, heritage, Texas-made
segments.behavioral: researches before $400+ buys; wary of online sizing; buys at events/stores

methods.recruitment: 250 public Judge.me reviews on chisos.com, keyword-coded (collected 2026-11-07)
Chisos product/sizing pages, fit quiz, events vs Tecovas/Lucchese positioning
Intercept survey at fit-event sites + founder interview (founder does public interviews)

findings.finding: 93% four-plus-star on quality across 250 reviews - 'soft leather', 'cushioned insoles', craftsmanship is loved; the product is not the problem
Complaints cluster on sizing/fit ('struggle', 'hurt', 'instep') - the only recurring negative is the fit gamble DTC can't resolve
Reviewers mention YouTube reviews and word-of-mouth - discovery runs on trust channels, not ads
Repeat buyers exist ('bought two pairs') but fit complaints persist across them - the friction is structural, not a bad batch

assumptions.text: $5,500 paid social at ~$8 CPM = ~690K impressions + ~110K organic
6 micro creators (Texas lifestyle/boot niche) at $400 each
8 fit-event shifts at ~$350 each (venue, fitting tools, signage)
FITTED code: free sizing consultation + $25 off first pair; netted

programs.name: Get Fitted Events
programs.mechanic: Pop-up fitting stations at Texas venues (gun shows, western events, malls): Brannock fitting + try-on wall + 'your size, guaranteed' card + QR. Solves the fit gamble in person.

programs.name: The Fit Guide
programs.mechanic: Online sizing-guide funnel: QR -> video fit quiz -> 'recommended size' -> first-pair offer. Mirrors the event for the DTC funnel.

programs.name: Texas Boot Stories
programs.mechanic: Founder/customer content: 'why Texans buy Chisos' - craft process, break-in stories, event clips. Trust-channel native (YouTube-heavy per R3).

programs.name: Gift a Pair
programs.mechanic: Giftable positioning: gift card + sizing consultation + 'the gift of a real fit' to gifters [R4].

slides.title: Campaign Overview
bullets: Problem: 93% of reviewers love the craftsmanship, but every complaint circles the same thing - fit is a gamble online, and a $450 boot is a big gamble [R1][R2].
Solution: Get Fitted - pop-up fitting events, an online fit-guide funnel, Texas-native trust content, giftable pairs.
45-day goal: 120 orders, 500 captures, +12 pts 'Chisos gets the fit right' [O1-O3].
slides.notes: Sell the fit, not the boot.

slides.title: The Product
bullets: Handcrafted cowboy boots: real leather, cushioned insoles, $300-600 - Austin-made, 90% sold DTC [S1][S3].
Reviews: 'soft leather', 'cushioned', 'beautifully made' - quality is proven [R1].
The risk is fit, not product: you can't try on a boot through a screen [R2].
Founder does public interviews - the story is accessible [S3].
slides.notes: Hold the boot up - '$450 on a screen is a gamble. That's the whole problem.'

slides.title: Company & Position
bullets: Independent Austin bootmaker - 250+ verified reviews, events-driven sales model, founder-accessible [S1][S2][S3].
Texas boot culture is real - Tecovas scaled on it; Chisos is the craft-first alternative [S4].
Positioning gap: 'handmade Texas boots' is crowded; 'the boot that fits you' is unclaimed.
Campaign claims the fit guarantee.

slides.title: Target Market
bullets: P1: Texas boot buyers 25-54 - professionals + ranch-adjacent who want real boots; research-heavy, fit-wary; Austin/Central Texas [S4].
P2: gift-buyers + collectors 30-60 - heritage purchases, holiday-driven [R4].
P1 carries the fit problem; P2 carries revenue.

slides.title: Research Methodology & Results
bullets: Content analysis of 250 public Judge.me reviews (collected 2026-11-07), keyword-coded [R1-R4].
Digital shelf audit of 8 sources: sizing pages, fit quiz, events vs Tecovas [S1][S4][S5].
Pending: intercept survey (n=150) at fit events + founder interview - founder takes public calls [S3].
250 reviews with real fit-complaint themes - the problem is visible in the data.

slides.title: Insights -> Campaign Decisions
bullets: [R1] Quality is loved (93% four-plus) -> sell craftsmanship + fit, not product fixes.
[R2] Complaints are sizing/fit -> the whole campaign is the fix: fitting events + online fit guide.
[R3] Discovery runs on YouTube/word-of-mouth -> trust-channel content over flashy ads.
[R4] Repeat buyers exist -> collector/gift programs compound the base.

bullets: Theme: Get Fitted - the boot brand that guarantees the fit.

PESO: paid geo-social, earned Texas-event PR, shared craft stories, owned email/SMS + fit guide.

slides.title: Budget & Financial Viability
bullets: Total $12,450: paid social $5.5K [A4]; creators $2.4K [A6]; events $2.8K [A7]; production $650 [A10]; contingency ~10% [A11].
Funnel: 800K impressions x 2.5% CTR x 0.6% purchase = ~120 orders = $54K revenue [A1][A4].
GP 50% = $27K; direct ROI ~+134% base - a $450 AOV changes the math: 120 orders covers the budget [A2][A13].
Conservative (50%): 60 orders, ROI ~+17% - still positive; the first candidate whose math works [A15].

slides.title: Why It Matters
bullets: Chisos sells a $450 product people are afraid to buy online - not because of the boots, but because of the fit. [S1]
Get Fitted removes the fear: real fitting, real guarantee, real Texas trust - and the judges hold the product.
A boot you can touch beats a boot on a screen - the demo is the product.
